'''Brandon Morreale''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[July 2001 Mount Prospect tournament]] on 14 July 2001 with Build the Death Star II without Endor Ops, according to Kevin James's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2654">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-mt-prospect-il-7-14-01d2654/ mt-prospect-il-7-14-01], DeckTech (Kevin "Obi-Kev" James, 17 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-mt-prospect-il-7-14-01d2654/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
